notes: Beta line, 1.3.4-beta. Same bottom line as stable: the crash right after signing in is gone, and the same UI pass shipped — your own picture in the header, an Account shortcut, a bell for unread notices, a home feed that stops repeating the same track, and a few cleaner heads and empty pages. Beta is the line I review before it goes out, so nothing here ships without a look. Install this line separately from stable. If a screen still gives trouble, ORU now shows the reason on screen and can copy it to you.
